name: tempest-wg6100-1981
description: Tempest (1981, Atari 'Quadrascan'): colour vector on a Wells-Gardner 6100 — a stock RCA 19VLUP22 100-degree in-line shadow-mask colour TV tube (P22 triad + delta mask), proving colour vector was just a raster tube with different drive electronics. The slowest slew of any arcade vector (Y 0.0375 in/us) rounds corners; misconvergence fringes the edges in RGB; and with no pincushion correction the geometry bows. The shadow mask legitimately rides the strokes here (mono vector has none).
